sessionClassiq01.name: Classic Session
sessionClassiq01.setup:
Big Shot chooses a bounty, which has one groove and one secret for each approach.

• Big Shot gains one Risk per player at the table, including themself.
• Each bounty hunter rolls 1d6 and gains that many Rhythm points.
• Each bounty hunter may gain one additional Rhythm point by giving Big Shot a new Risk, as many times as they wish, without exceeding six Rhythm at the start of the session.
• If at least one bounty hunter rolled a 6, they choose the Session Genre; otherwise Big Shot chooses it. The bounty's secret is tied to that Genre.
• Big Shot sets up an introduction and announces the session title.

Three Movements in order — OK, then 3, 2, 1…, then Let's Jam! — followed by See You Space Cowboy… as the denouement.

sessionPersonn02.name: Personal Session
sessionPersonn02.setup:
Triggered when a bounty hunter checks their last cartridge: their character steps into the spotlight. It follows the structure of a Classic Session, with a few adjustments.

• Do not roll for Rhythm: each bounty hunter gains as much Rhythm as they have checked cartridges.
• During the session, Rhythm may be spent instead of checking a cartridge to get involved or correct false notes.
• At the end, every cylinder is cleared. Big Shot gains as many Risks as the bounty hunters' combined remaining Rhythm points.

The spotlighted bounty hunter chooses a burden whose story will appear in the session, then chooses one aspect to control: the Genre and title, setting up the introduction, or setting up the conclusion. The other bounty hunters collectively choose one of the two remaining aspects, and Big Shot takes the last.

The session does not end with See You Space Cowboy… On a success, the bounty hunter marks an X beside the burden used.

sessionFiller003.name: Filler Session
sessionFiller003.setup:
An episode that steps away from the main plot: lower stakes, with characters changing and growing closer. A Filler Session needs neither a bounty nor a Genre — still create a bounty bearing the episode title, since it carries the session.

• Each bounty hunter starts with one Rhythm point per UNCHECKED cartridge, plus one per burden.
• Cartridges are not used: spend one Rhythm point instead.
• Big Shot gains one Risk per checked cartridge on the character sheets, with a minimum of one.

Structure, chosen by Big Shot:
• Reversed — the session starts with Let's Jam!, continues with 3, 2, 1…, and ends with OK. Everyone becomes less and less able to help their comrades, ultimately facing their burden alone.
• Freeform — choose a single Movement; everyone keeps its benefits throughout the session. Set up a few activities as H–4 clocks, one per player; the session ends when they are all closed.
• Your own structure.

No repeats: this is an opportunity to invent. New riffs, new Movement options, different ways to assist or improvise — add them here, Movement by Movement.

Ending: each bounty hunter may move a trait to another approach, rename a burden, or change a trait. Each failure removes one of these options for everyone.

sessionPivotSa04.name: Season Pivot
sessionPivotSa04.setup:
A double session focused on memories, played when every bounty hunter bears at least one burden. It is played again as the campaign finale when everyone has two burdens and one hunter has three.

First session
• Each bounty hunter gains three Rhythm points, plus two for each burden in their memory.
• Big Shot chooses the Genre and gains one Risk per player, including themself, plus two for each burden without an X. They note one such burden for each bounty hunter and strive to involve them all.
• Big Shot applies the bounty rules — groove and secret — to an enemy already present in the story, then chooses a second approach and a second secret for them.
• Play proceeds like a Classic Session through Let's Jam! At the end, whether the hunters succeed or fail, the enemy reveals that the second secret puts the characters in danger: the session ends on this cliffhanger and nobody turns the page.

Second session
• Big Shot chooses the Genre. The bounty hunters gain one Rhythm point per checked cartridge, as in a Personal Session, and may spend Rhythm instead of checking a cartridge.
• At the end, every cartridge is cleared and Big Shot gains as many Risks as the bounty hunters' combined remaining Rhythm points.
• Play proceeds like a Classic Session through the end of Let's Jam!

Ending: the bounty hunters may change their character's groove. On a success, each marks an X beside an appropriate burden.
